_doc: What the File tab collects. Patches unlock by a rule the phone checks: day N reached, votes cast, rescues answered, gifts sent, cliffhangers seen, drops opened, artifacts found, story % discovered, watch streak. Artifacts come from rare drops and rare job results. Crew file entries unlock per crewmate as your astronaut gets to know them. STUBS: the content pass replaces these.

patches.t: Seven days out. Earth still fills the window.
Past the point where turning back is cheaper.
Someone asked for help and you answered.
Something small, sent a long way.
You were there when the log stopped mid-sentence.
Half of this voyage's story discovered.

artifacts.t: First crewed flight. One corner burnt. It gets quieter.
Seven ships, the night before. Numbers in pen.
Fifty years out and still talking.
A micrometeoroid, smaller than a grain of rice. Dated.

file._doc: Three entries per crewmate. met: they appear in your log. shared: your astronaut and they share a log line. traded: a gift or ask between you. {T} = crewmate, {S} = their ship, {lean} = their strongest character word.
file.met: {T}, {S}. On the manifest and in the log.
file.shared: Has worked a shift alongside your astronaut. Reads as {lean}.
traded: Keeps a paper notebook of every alarm ever silenced.
Packed one real mug. Drinks from a pouch anyway.
Labels every cable, including the labelled ones.
Has a favourite wrench and won't say which.
Can name every star the tracker uses.
Keeps the last letter from home unopened, for a bad day.
Hums during checklists. Always the same tune.
